`stb_image.h` and `LICENSE` are vendored from https://github.com/nothings/stb at commit `2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20` (stb_image v2.30), so the eightamps WASM build fetches nothing from GitHub. `eightamps/build-wasm.sh` points the build here with `-DSTB_IMAGE_INCLUDE_DIR`. To update, replace both files from a newer stb commit and change that commit in this file and in `eightamps/build-wasm.sh`.
